params.caption: Darsda o'qituvchi "Give me an example" desa, miya bir zumda bo'm-bo'sh bo'lib qoladimi? Aynan shu holat uchun inglizlarda qulay ibora bor: come up with, ya'ni biror g'oya, yechim yoki javobni o'ylab topmoq. She came up with a great idea for our project. Loyihamiz uchun zo'r g'oya o'ylab topdi. We need to come up with a solution by Friday. Jumagacha yechim topishimiz kerak. I couldn't come up with a good answer. Yaxshi javob topa olmadim. Bu iboraning bo'laklari ajralmaydi, shuning uchun olmosh oxirida turadi: come up with it deyiladi, come it up with emas. Ortidan doim nimadir keladi: an idea, a plan, a name, an excuse. Speaking'da bemalol ishlating. Rasmiyroq essay'da esa o'rniga develop yoki propose ham chiroyli chiqadi: The government should develop a new plan.
